basic_info.description: Welcome to 3023 Alemany Blvd! This spacious and versatile home offers exceptional living in a well-connected neighborhood.The upper level features 3 bedrooms and 2 full baths, all filled with abundant natural light. Enjoy an open floor plan with a bright, remodeled kitchen complete with granite countertops perfect for everyday living and entertaining. The lower level includes a legal unit (per 3R report) with 1 bedroom, 1 full bath, and a generous family room, ideal for extended family, guests, or multi-generational living. Whether you need space for a large household or two families, this home has it all. Conveniently located near transit, public transportation, shops, and major freeways, it offers both comfort and convenience.Don't miss this must-see opportunity!
